name: cross-surface-journey-closure
executionConcern: multi-surface readback, failure semantics, compatibility and final journey closure
objective: Close multi-surface readback, failure semantics, compatibility and final journey closure end to end without losing canonical ownership, authorization, readback or directly affected surface compatibility.
truthOwner: Canonical domain owners remain authoritative; Control Panel writes are complete only when committed truth, audit evidence and directly affected surface readbacks converge.

tasks.objective: Prove every Control Panel section and control class on the final candidate
tasks.currentProblem: Static completeness does not prove all sections obey authorization, failure, readback and accessibility requirements.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute section-registry and journey-linked scenarios across all Control Panel areas and directly affected surfaces.
tasks.targetState: No section, hidden route or required control scenario remains unverified on the exact candidate SHA.
tasks.action: Build the final matrix from Control Panel registry and current route/service inventory; run negative, degraded, retry, readback and RTL/accessibility scenarios; record evidence.
mustNotChange: Do not create parallel domain truth or client-trusted authorization context.
Do not broaden execution into repository areas without a proven Control Panel dependency.
Do not weaken audit, idempotency, conflict or canonical-readback guarantees to make the UI appear successful.
acceptanceCriteria: No section, hidden route or required control scenario remains unverified on the exact candidate SHA.
Forbidden/wrong-scope and dependency/error states fail explicitly rather than fabricating success.
State-changing actions are verified by canonical readback and directly affected surfaces where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U005 implementation commit after owner correction, affected-consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Validate package closure and repository compatibility
tasks.currentProblem: Partial unit success can hide cross-surface regressions or evidence tied to an older candidate.
tasks.requiredChange: Run package validator plus targeted frontend/backend/database/runtime suites and bind every result to the resulting SHA.
tasks.targetState: All required checks pass, direct mobile readbacks converge, no unrelated path is changed, and closure has no blocker/deviation.
